title: 中山金杯の後に・幸先ええで！

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yesss! Didja see dat?! I got first place, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is overjoyed with her win at the Nakayama Kimpai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly before we decided to enter the race…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm beggin' ya, Trainer! Lemme run in the Kimpai!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why? 'Cause winnin' that race is real lucky. We gotta be there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Comin' in first would bring all kinds of luck my way. 'Sides, it's the first race of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna blast down that track 'n stock up on some good fortune. Sounds good, right? Whaddaya say?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch, Trainer. This gonna be one lucky year!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That goes for both of us! Y'know, since you're the one who let me compete!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And after that, we can divvy up all the luck with the fans down in Kyoto! Handouts all round!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Racecourse is teeming with Tamamo Cross's fans, and she has a smile for every last one.
